layer-01-matter.title: Matter Data Model
layer-01-matter.owns_truth: Supabase canonical Matter record and child evidence keyed to deals.id; deal_id is the public Matter reference.
layer-01-matter.may_change: Matter lifecycle and canonical record fields only through approved Matter mutation paths.
layer-01-matter.evidence: Canonical row IDs, timestamps, authenticated ownership, files/evidence records, audit lineage.
layer-01-matter.tests: One Matter UUID from intake to release; no duplicate/orphan child authority; ownership isolation.

layer-02-business-rules.title: Core Business Rules
layer-02-business-rules.owns_truth: Server-side governed lifecycle, readiness and transition rules.
layer-02-business-rules.may_change: Authorize or block lifecycle transitions; never fabricate provider truth.
layer-02-business-rules.evidence: Canonical Matter facts plus explicit operator/provider evidence where required.
layer-02-business-rules.tests: Invalid transitions fail; unknown != ready/rejected; payment authority != RON readiness.

layer-03-pricing.title: Pricing & Scope
layer-03-pricing.may_change: Quote/scope/discount state only; cannot author payment or execution completion.
layer-03-pricing.evidence: Pricing inputs, rule version, scope and discount provenance.
layer-03-pricing.tests: Quote determinism, discount eligibility, public/professional boundary, no pricing authority drift.

layer-04-intake.title: Client / Professional Intake
layer-04-intake.owns_truth: Validated intake creates or updates the canonical Matter.
layer-04-intake.may_change: Create intake Matter/evidence only; cannot mark payment, execution, apostille or release complete.
layer-04-intake.evidence: Validated form payload, authenticated/professional context and uploaded documents.
layer-04-intake.tests: Validation, retry idempotency, upload ownership, professional/client routing.

layer-05-ron.title: RON / Execution
layer-05-ron.owns_truth: Canonical scheduling/RON guards plus BlueNotary provider evidence.
layer-05-ron.may_change: Scheduling and RON state only through canonical guards/provider events.
layer-05-ron.evidence: Scheduling gate result, explicit notarial facts, signer data, provider resource/status evidence.
layer-05-ron.tests: Wise submission scheduling, notarial review, idempotent session creation, provider-completion boundary.

layer-06-apostille.title: Apostille / Authentication
layer-06-apostille.owns_truth: Execution/apostille workflow state backed by document and authority-route evidence.
layer-06-apostille.may_change: Apostille/authentication state only from governed operator/provider evidence.
layer-06-apostille.evidence: Document version, issuing authority, route decision, submission/return references and returned document.
layer-06-apostille.tests: State/federal and Hague/non-Hague routing, evidence-required completion, translation dependencies.

layer-07-operator.title: Operator Console
layer-07-operator.owns_truth: No independent truth; operator surfaces project canonical Matter state and invoke governed authorities.
layer-07-operator.may_change: Only through existing mutation authorities with actor/role/reason/evidence receipts.
layer-07-operator.evidence: Actor role, decision receipt, previous/new state, reason and evidence.
layer-07-operator.tests: Role checks, decision receipts, queue derivation, no browser-local authority.

layer-08-wise.title: Wise Payments
layer-08-wise.owns_truth: Wise provider evidence plus canonical payment confirmation authority.
layer-08-wise.may_change: Payment observation, reconciliation and paid truth through canonical Wise authority.
layer-08-wise.evidence: Wise reference, amount, currency, provider resource, observed and settled timestamps.
layer-08-wise.tests: Wise-only; submission != settlement; exact amount/currency/reference/resource; duplicate-safe reconciliation.

layer-09-economics.title: Economics / Reporting
layer-09-economics.owns_truth: Read models derived from canonical financial and operational records.
layer-09-economics.evidence: Observed costs/revenue and source provenance; modeled/attributed values remain explicitly labeled.
layer-09-economics.tests: Observed != modeled; Unknown stays Unknown; no fabricated revenue or margin.

layer-10-notifications.title: Notifications
layer-10-notifications.owns_truth: Lifecycle events and delivery provider receipts; notifications never author Matter state.
layer-10-notifications.evidence: Lifecycle event, recipient, template/version, provider message ID/status, retries.
layer-10-notifications.tests: Event-template mapping, dedupe, retries and client/internal separation.

layer-11-corridor.title: Corridor Intelligence
layer-11-corridor.owns_truth: Read model derived from Matter, execution, authority and corridor evidence.
layer-11-corridor.may_change: No transactional state; corridor posture/readiness only.
layer-11-corridor.evidence: Origin/destination, document type, authority freshness, exception/rework history and provenance.
layer-11-corridor.tests: Corridor reasons, freshness, scale-posture semantics and insufficient-evidence state.

layer-12-security.title: Security / Compliance
layer-12-security.owns_truth: Server roles, RLS, immutable audit/security evidence and canonical release authority.
layer-12-security.may_change: Security/audit/approval evidence and final release only through canonical server authority.
layer-12-security.evidence: Authenticated actor/role, RLS, decision/audit receipts, custody and release evidence.
layer-12-security.tests: RLS/role coverage, service-role-only evidence paths, no client release authority, audit durability.
anchors: lib/control-plane/governance (corporate scope only; no client Matter mutation)

layer-13-config.title: Platform Configuration
layer-13-config.may_change: Configuration state only through deployment/admin controls.
layer-13-config.evidence: Versioned config, deployment metadata, validated environment/provider settings.
layer-13-config.tests: Environment validation, cron auth, provider configuration and no secret leakage.

layer-14-finance.title: Finance / Settlement Operations
layer-14-finance.owns_truth: Wise settlement evidence and finance exception workflows; paid truth remains Layer 8 authority.
layer-14-finance.may_change: Settlement/accounting evidence and exception workflow only.
layer-14-finance.evidence: Wise gross/fee/net, provider evidence, settlement timestamps and exception history.
layer-14-finance.tests: Gross=net+fee evidence, exception handling, accounting/payment authority separation.

layer-15-validation.title: Production Validation
layer-15-validation.owns_truth: Exact source SHA + production deployment + real evidence-backed certification.
layer-15-validation.may_change: Certification artifacts only; tests cannot mutate production truth just to pass.
layer-15-validation.evidence: Test output, provider evidence, production logs, exact SHA/deployment and same-Matter continuity.
layer-15-validation.tests: Typecheck, lint, full tests, migration chain, responsive/mobile, runtime and E2E certification.
